summary: Iteration 14: verified upcoming (projected) recurring rows are now editable/deletable and swipe-right paid toggle works. Backend: tests/test_iter14_upcoming_skip_override.py 14/14 PASS (skip, occurrence override, 404 bad/foreign rid, 422 missing body, 401 unauth, materialize_due respects exceptions, PUT series cascade, tx CRUD/paid). Frontend (375x667, admin): ALL requested flows PASS end-to-end incl. mouse-drag swipe and CDP touch-emulated swipe. Upcoming expense tap -> 'Edit recurring transaction?' -> 'Only this transaction' prefilled -> save -> row became a real row with edited amount/description (POST /occurrence). Upcoming income (Bonus) same. 'Update entire series' -> series banner shown, PUT applied to projection + materialized rows. Swipe-left on upcoming expense and upcoming income -> red Delete -> 'Delete recurring transaction?' -> 'Just this one' -> row gone (skip). 'Delete entire series' on upcoming row removed that series. Pencil on upcoming row works; header trash in add-transaction for an upcoming occurrence skips it. Real income: tap edit (44->46 saved), swipe-left delete OK. Real expense swipe right toggled paid->unpaid->paid (mouse) and paid->unpaid (touch), row closes. Swipe right on upcoming expense created a real paid tx. Income rows (real + upcoming) do not swipe right. Regression OK: non-recurring delete confirm, recurring real 'Just this one', filters All/Paid/Unpaid, balance card totals update. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: original_date gets added to exceptions BEFORE insert_one. If the insert fails (409 duplicate), the exception stays, so the projected copy is hidden but no real transaction exists. Add the exception only after a successful insert, or roll it back in the except block (server.py ~1002-1008).
Accepts any date string without checking it is a real occurrence of the rule. Low risk, but the exceptions list can fill up with junk.

Updating the whole series runs update_many over every transaction in the series. This overwrites single-occurrence overrides: Nov Bonus edited to 75 went back to 60. Decide whether 'Update entire series' should leave individually edited occurrences alone.

ui_bugs.issue: The projected row is built with paid:true (index.tsx:93), so goEdit passes paid='1'. An edited future bill is saved as PAID (TEST_UIRent_edited came back paid=True with a green check). A future expense edited ahead of time should probably default to unpaid unless the user marks it paid.

'N upcoming' pill adds real unpaid expenses to the projected rows (index.tsx:162-165). In October it showed '1 upcoming' when there was only a real unpaid expense and no projected rows. Change the label to 'unpaid' or count them separately.

action_items: Default paid=false (for expenses) when saving an edited upcoming occurrence via 'Only this transaction', or show the paid state on the edit form.
In override_occurrence, add the exception only after the insert succeeds (or roll it back on 409).
Decide whether PUT /recurring/{rid} should skip transactions that were individually overridden.
Rename or split the 'N upcoming' count pill, since it also counts real unpaid expenses.
Tell the user that both features work in the current bundle. Their report probably came from an older bundle, so they should reload the app or Expo Go.
critical_code_review_comments: Edited-occurrence dates are saved without a timezone (e.g. '2026-11-10T14:53:46' from toIsoWithNowTime), while rule-generated dates carry '+00:00'. This mixed format already existed but can affect string sorting and month-boundary comparisons.

test_user_profile.py renames the shared admin account to 'TEST_Updated_Name' and never restores it. The dashboard greeting showed 'TEST_Updated_Name.' I restored it to 'Admin' via PATCH /api/users/me; that test should restore the name in teardown or use its own user.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI* recurring rules + transactions on admin via seed_iter14_ui.py; all cleaned up (python tests/seed_iter14_ui.py cleanup). Admin name restored to 'Admin'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server date is ~Oct 2026. Upcoming row testIDs: tx-proj-{rid}-{ISO date}, delete: tx-delete-proj-..., edit: tx-edit-proj-..., paid panel tx-swipe-paid-{id}. Mouse-drag swipe (180px in 10 steps, 16ms) works; touch swipe works only after CDP Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled.
